integrity: The structural equalities are proved algebraically for every every permitted rim size; the executable finite tests are corroboration, not the source of the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Open-neighbour binary XOR rule on W_n only; not majority, threshold or asynchronous dynamics.
Polynomial gcd formulas for primitive cycles are exact but not uniformly simplified to a list of attainable lengths.
The origin date is the first verified day-precision public arXiv submission supporting the research direction; older 1988 work is acknowledged without inventing a day.
The finding has not been independently audited and unindexed equivalent literature may exist.
title: A two-adic transient law and exact orbit census for XOR dynamics on wheel graphs
